Desktop - Core consolidation - Merge cmd + page + hud resident renderers into the core background renderer — app/index.js now awaits initCmd(), initPage(), initHud(); cmd-glue.ts, page-glue.ts, hud-glue.ts and the three resident shim HTMLs deleted - Fix ext:all-loaded subscribe-after-publish race that was silently dropping 26 core commands (quit/restart/back/forward/reload/settings/theme-* etc) on cold start — registry now grows 72→96 - Fix Electron 40 console-message forwarder — event level is a string literal in E40, not an int, so the numeric filter dropped all renderer output - Move macOS did-become-active / did-resign-active overlay-hide/show handlers inline into main.ts (no longer owned by hud-glue) - Remove unused helpdocs feature
Desktop - Tile preload migration (Phase 3.11) - Delete preload.js — cmd panel, chain-editor, canvas page host, settings, HUD overlay + widgets, datastore viewer, navigator, session, diagnostic all migrated to tile-preload.cjs - Delete legacy extensionHostWindow + host HTML + v1 branch of the extension broadcaster (Phase 3.10) - Delete IPC_CHANNELS const + 6 dead ipcMain.on handlers (Phase 3.11c) - Strict shims for tile:theme:, tile:extensions:, tile:chrome-extensions:, tile:window:opener-, tile:features:settings-schema, tile:window:get-id, tile:log:write, tile:app:quit/restart, tile:backup/shell/app — all trustedBuiltin-gated - Flip datastore, app-control, theme, extension-, opener-, features-schema, get-window-id to strict + delete legacy (Phase 3.6 sweep) - Migrate 6 features to the v2 settings API, fix datastore tableName param mismatch - Route about:blank and cmd panel / chain-editor through tile-preload (Cat 4 IZUI fix)
Desktop - Feature tile conversions - Collapse groups, tag-actions, lex, entities, websearch into single-tile resident form — drop cross-window pubsub round-trips - Migrate callers from legacy peek://ext/{id} to v2 peek://{id} — plus test-URL sweep
Desktop - Pubsub + tile-preload - Auto-initialize tile-preload at module load — remove the call-order trap - Register v2 window-entries opened via api.window.open with the tile broadcaster (they weren't being forwarded global publishes) - Broadcaster now reaches webview guests (peek:// URLs), not just BrowserWindows - Echo-prevention compares full URL, not just peek host — fixes sibling-window dropped pubsub inside the same feature - HUD widget init: initialize() calls, getExtKey shape fix - tile-preload getBounds / getDisplayInfo / setBounds + unwrap getWindowId result
Desktop - Testing - Split smoke.spec.ts (2000+ lines, 29 describes) into one-file-per-describe for parallelism - Add desktop-serial Playwright project (workers: 1) for OS-integration-fragile tests - Per-describe Electron isolation via createPerDescribeApp() — kills cross-test state leaks - Disable cmd-panel close-on-blur + showSelf window.show under headless - Test module-health check — detects silent module-halt regressions from api drift - Deterministic window:opened-event wait in external-url test (no more 500ms sleep) - Fix tag-widget page-widget flake: per-test URL + key, gate on __pageModuleReady, poll for quit/restart registration - Rewrite cmd chain tests around canonical OUTPUT_SELECTION → CHAIN_MODE flow - Delete v1 api.commands.flush batching tests (no-op in v2)
Desktop - Other fixes - Register will-download handler on webview guest session — fixes download-popup not being cleaned up - Preserve window size during drag-out-of-maximize in page host - Page widget updates reactively for tag events - Restore minimal cmd:register-batch publish + merge-preserve pattern in cmd resident - setWindowColorScheme window resolution in headless (Cat 3 theme fix) - ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE import compat for schema codegen - atproto signature-verification plan written (implementation pending)

Desktop - Page Host - Error hardening: webview crash handler with reload overlay, show/hide opacity safety, myWindowId retry, global unhandledrejection handler - Fix stuck loading on redirect URLs (bsky.app/redirect) — meta-refresh loop breaker, latestNavigationUrl tracking - Fix OAuth callback URLs breaking page host — modal auth window, filter localhost callbacks from session restore - Unified popup handler — JS-opened links from modals/overlays now open in proper page host with navbar/widgets
Desktop - Cmd Panel - Fix Tab completion entering param mode too early on partial command match - Fix kagi search tab completion — stale command cache validation, robust query extraction fallbacks - Fix search engine param forwarding from manifest through lazy command registration - Cmd+N opens new page host window with about:blank, inherits active space mode, navbar focused
Desktop - Lex (AT Protocol) - Bluesky post composer: rich text facet detection (mentions/links/hashtags with byte offsets), 300-grapheme counter, image embed upload (up to 4), live preview - Phase 4 advanced types: union type sub-forms, external ref resolution, blob drag-and-drop upload, collapsible nested objects, client-side field validation with inline errors
Desktop - Undo Close Window - Fix reopen — skip URL dedup for reopen requests, prevent double-push on quit - Persistent across restarts — stack saved to DB, all open windows pushed on quit for crash recovery - Works for all window types — peek:// windows (groups, spaces, tags) saved and reopened with correct role
Desktop - Spaces - Spaces feature: machine tags (space: prefix), auto-tagging, screen border, session management - extension_settings → feature_settings rename across ~40 files with SQL migration - Backend cleanup: strip ~250 lines of space-specific logic from ipc.ts, move to feature layer - Groups simplified: tags == groups, remove promote/demote, pure data browser
Desktop - Other - Fix maximize race condition with drag/resize handlers - Add reactivity to search, lists, and entities views (sync:pull-completed, item:created/deleted) - Fix windows switcher always focusing same window — overlay focus target mechanism - Persistent undo-close-window stack (50 entries, survives restart) - Proton Pass WebAuthn/passkey support via main-world injection - Favicon gaps: preload API, Google favicon fallback, entity enrichment persistence - Page maximize feature restored (was lost in prior overwrites) - Entity filter bar in tags view - Shichijuni theme missing font variables - 7 Claude Code skills: /ship, /fix, /test, /release, /explore, /review, /ios-build
Desktop - Testing - Space mode tests: machine tags, auto-tagging, mode preservation, border visibility - Page host tests: loading abort, navigation guards, favicon fallback, maximize layout - Closed window tests: stack persistence, space mode capture, all window types - Cmd state machine: Tab partial match guard

Desktop - Groups - Scope group mode to window lineage — prevent group tag leakage to items from external apps, cmd palette, peeks, slides - Add group screen border indicator — colored overlay with group name label, tracks focused window's mode - Focus-based border visibility — border shows only when focused window is a group member, not globally - Modal window exemption — cmd palette doesn't hide border during group work - Assign vivid colors to groups at creation/promotion — deterministic palette selection for desaturated defaults - Add color picker to group detail header — clickable color dot next to rename icon - Always show tags section in groups view — remove toggle, display groups and tags as separate sections with divider - Increase default window size from 800x600 to 1024x768 across groups, tags, search, wonderwall
Desktop - Page View - Fix j/k/g/G keys blocked in tags input and notes panel — pagestream nav handler now checks for focused input elements - Fix findWindowByUrl to only match page-host windows — skip peeks, slides, modals for URL dedup
Desktop - Shutdown - Fix shutdown hang from group screen border overlay — destroy overlay window and clear timers in before-quit handler
Desktop - Testing - Add 45 group-mode unit tests — color resolution, leakage prevention, lineage scoping, focus-based border, modal exemption - Add 70 pagestream key navigation guard tests

Desktop - IZUI Navigation - ESC at root opens Windows switcher — new escUnhandledPolicy second-phase policy for workspace windows in active/idle sessions - Preserve role/escapeMode across session restore — fix canvas mode check to not depend on role
Desktop - Editor - Add img tag rendering in preview — sanitized HTML img tags with attribute allowlist and protocol security - Support relative image paths and file:// protocol — resolve images relative to edited file via peek://local-file/ protocol
Desktop - Groups - Restructure group detail view header — group name, edit icon, view mode buttons, and inline sort controls in compact layout - Remove colored dot from group header
Desktop - Shortcuts - Change Pagestream shortcut from Cmd/Ctrl+P to Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P (avoids conflict with Print)
Desktop - Docs - Update README — rewrite intro, add desktop screenshot, Core/Features/Keyboard Shortcuts/Feature API sections - Rename extension terminology to features throughout docs and README - Rename docs/extensions.md → features.md, extension-modes.md → feature-modes.md, extension-settings-api.md → feature-settings-api.md

Desktop - Extensions - Fix extension ID mismatch — config.js IDs now match manifest IDs, fixing websearch and other lazy-loaded commands - Fix ext:ready ordering — all extensions call init() before publishing ext:ready, fixing cold-start command execution - Assert-and-trust lazy loading — remove polling, resolve immediately on ext:ready with subscriber verification - Fix websearch BroadcastChannel origin mismatch — switch to IPC pubsub for cross-origin communication
Desktop - Windows - URL-based window dedup — opening same http/https URL focuses existing window instead of creating duplicate - Fix window centering on display switch — use cursor display instead of primary display - Fix download navigation — page stays loaded when clicking download links, cleanup blank popups
Desktop - Page View - Add link hover tooltip — status bar shows URL destination on webview link hover
Desktop - Search - Migrate search list view to standard peek-card components
Desktop - Groups - Add remove-from-group icon on URL item cards in group detail view
Desktop - Testing - Add Playwright tests for websearch commands, window URL handling, and download navigation
Mobile - Android safe area, dark mode, crash fix, launcher icons, editor layout, 16KB alignment - Dual simulator dev command, DRY item components, fix iOS/Android crate-type conflict - Fullscreen image tap, today/later toggle, markdown reader mode for notes
